sprites_page_info: A complete collection of all Yuyuko sprites from official games, including bullet hell and fighting games. Includes gameplay sprites, character sprites from dialogue scenes, and more.
mangas_page_info: A collection of official manga panels featuring Yuyuko, primarily from 'Silent Sinner in Blue' and 'Foul Detective Satori'. A reader is available for more comfortable viewing.
fanarts_page_info: Section for exploring and uploading Yuyuko fan art. Tags implemented to help with searching and categorizing.

body_section_general_informarion: Yuyuko's in-game sprites; these include those shown during gameplay, character selection, backgrounds, dialogue sequences, and more. Yuyuko has appeared in numerous games; Touhou 7, 8, 9, 10.5, 12.3, 13, and 13.5 and is a playable character in three of them (one bullet hell game [8] and two fighting games [10.5, 12.3]).
sprites_info_gameplay: Sprites displayed during gameplay. Yuyuko appears as a boss in Touhou 7 and 13, and as a playable character in installments 8, 10.5, and 12.3.
sprites_credits_zun_twi: Games creators: Team Shanghai Alice (ZUN) and Twilight Frontier.
sprites_info_selection: Sprites displayed on the character selection.
sprites_info_dialogues: Sprites displayed during dialogue with Yuyuko.
sprites_info_endings: Screens displayed at the end of games.
sprites_info_background: Stage backgrounds for the levels where you face Yuyuko (or backgrounds related to her).
sprites_info_other: Various sprites, such as projectile effects or an appearance by Yuyuko as a background character.

general_info_p: In this section you can see pages of the official Touhou mangas in which Yuyuko appears, regularly as a secondary or tertiary character. The English translations shown are not official, corresponding credits will be listed.
silent_info: A story which involves the moon and its inhabitants; the lunarians. The plot consists of the girls of the Scarlet Devil Mansion building a spaceship to go to the moon, meanwhile Yukari Yakumo hatches a plan against the Lunarians.
silent_credits: Writer: ZUN | Illustrator: Aki★Eda | Translation group: Gaku Gaku Animal Land
foul_info: Incidents in which a vengeful spirit is involved affect the residents of Gensokyo, Detective Satori must investigate.
foul_credits: Writer: ZUN | Illustrators: Ginmokusei y Akimaki Yuu | Translation group: DB Scans
oriental_info: A continuation of the 'Strange and Bright Nature Deity' manga, it features the same plot centered on the trio of light fairies.
oriental_credits: Writer: ZUN | Illustrator: Makoto Hirasaka | Translation groups: Unknown (teesh)[Chapter 3], UMAD SCANS[Remaining chapters]
visionary_info: The hell fairy Clownpiece joins the group of fairies of light, apart from that, there is an incident in which strange crystals appear in Gensokyo
visionary_credits: Writer: ZUN | Illustrator: Makoto Hirasaka | Translation group: Alpha Beta Kappa
strange_info: A 'slide of life' that focuses on the three fairies of light getting into mischief.
strange_credits: Writer: ZUN | Illustrator: Makoto Hirasaka | Translation groups: UMAD SCANS[chapter 16.1], Gaku Gaku Animal Land[Remaining chapters]
